# What this file does

Self-contained. It rebuilds Figures 1 to 4 from the objects already saved in this
folder, with no refitting of the measurement models:

| Figure | Content | Source object |
|---|---|---|
| Fig. 1 | Class-enumeration diagnostics with adjacent-solution ARI | `lca_results.rds` (+ per-k modal assignments, see below) |
| Fig. 2 | Item-response probabilities of the retained four-class solution | `lca_results.rds$rho4` |
| Fig. 3 | Shared item-response probabilities under measurement invariance | `cache_g4_inv_part2.rds` (or `part2_cache_*.rds`) |
| Fig. 4 | Class prevalence by setting under the invariant model | same as Fig. 3 |

Three things are enforced everywhere:

1. **Canonical class numbering and labels**, derived from the behavioral
   signature and never from the raw `glca` index: C1 moderately constructive,
   C2 disengaged, C3 constructive, C4 ambivalent/intermittently destructive.
2. **Order C1 to C4** in every panel, legend and axis.
3. **A verification block that stops the render** if the class sizes or the
   per-setting prevalences do not reproduce the values reported in the
   manuscript. Relabelling a figure without re-checking its numbers is exactly
   how a figure ends up disagreeing with its table.

Journal specification applied: 174 mm two-column width, 600 dpi, Arial/Helvetica
via the `sans` family at 8 to 9 pt, no title inside the figure (captions go in the
text), panel tags **a**, **b**, **c**, colour plus a luminance-ordered ramp so the
figures survive greyscale printing.

# 0. Packages, helpers, item metadata

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| results: "hold"

for (.pkg in c("ggplot2", "dplyr", "tidyr", "tibble", "readr", "knitr", "patchwork")) {
  if (!requireNamespace(.pkg, quietly = TRUE))
    install.packages(.pkg, repos = "https://cloud.r-project.org")
  suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(.pkg, character.only = TRUE))
}
stopifnot(exists("ggplot"), exists("theme_bw"))

## ---- Journal geometry and theme --------------------------------------------
W_MM   <- 174      # Springer two-column width
DPI    <- 600      # combination art
BASE   <- 8.5      # pt; Springer asks for 8 to 12 pt lettering
FAM    <- "sans"   # maps to Arial/Helvetica on Windows and macOS

theme_j <- function(base_size = BASE) {
  theme_bw(base_size = base_size, base_family = FAM) +
    theme(panel.grid.minor   = element_blank(),
          panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
          panel.grid.major.x = element_line(linewidth = .25, colour = "grey88"),
          strip.background   = element_rect(fill = "grey95", colour = NA),
          strip.text         = element_text(face = "bold", size = base_size - 0.5),
          legend.position    = "top",
          ## Left-aligned rather than centred: with long category or setting
          ## labels a centred legend overflows the panel area on both sides and
          ## the outer entries are clipped.
          legend.justification = "left",
          legend.box.just    = "left",
          legend.margin      = margin(t = 0, r = 0, b = 2, l = 0),
          legend.title       = element_text(size = base_size - 0.5),
          legend.text        = element_text(size = base_size - 0.5),
          legend.key.height  = grid::unit(.7, "lines"),
          legend.key.width   = grid::unit(.9, "lines"),
          plot.title         = element_blank(),   # no title inside the figure
          plot.tag           = element_text(face = "bold", size = base_size + 1.5))
}

save_fig <- function(p, stem, h_mm) {
  ggsave(paste0(stem, ".png"), p, width = W_MM, height = h_mm, units = "mm",
         dpi = DPI, bg = "white")
  try(ggsave(paste0(stem, ".tiff"), p, width = W_MM, height = h_mm, units = "mm",
             dpi = DPI, bg = "white", compression = "lzw"), silent = TRUE)
  try(ggsave(paste0(stem, ".pdf"), p, width = W_MM, height = h_mm, units = "mm",
             device = grDevices::cairo_pdf), silent = TRUE)
  try(ggsave(paste0(stem, ".eps"), p, width = W_MM, height = h_mm, units = "mm",
             device = grDevices::cairo_ps, fallback_resolution = DPI), silent = TRUE)
  message("Wrote ", stem, ".png (+ vector/TIFF copies where the device allowed it)")
}

## ---- Item metadata (13 items; lid_des3 / p39_3 excluded) --------------------
## Order must match the order the models were fitted in. The stopifnot below
## turns a mismatch into a loud error instead of a silent off-by-one mislabel.
ITEM_LAB <- c("Humiliates employees", "Encourages creative ideas",
              "Gestures of displeasure", "Avoids making decisions",
              "Recognizes good performance", "Avoids involvement in work",
              "Spreads false information", "Absent when needed",
              "Berates by phone / rude email", "Seeks to develop capabilities",
              "Sets clear objectives", "Defines / explains tasks",
              "Flexible, open to innovation")
ITEM_TYPE <- factor(c("Destructive", "Constructive", "Destructive", "Laissez-faire",
                      "Constructive", "Laissez-faire", "Destructive", "Laissez-faire",
                      "Destructive", "Constructive", "Constructive", "Constructive",
                      "Constructive"),
                    levels = c("Destructive", "Laissez-faire", "Constructive"))
stopifnot(length(ITEM_LAB) == 13L, length(ITEM_TYPE) == 13L)

CATS    <- c("Never", "Sometimes", "Fairly often", "Almost always/always")
## Sequential single-hue ramp: monotone in luminance, so it also reads in greyscale.
CAT_PAL <- setNames(c("#EFF3FF", "#9ECAE1", "#4292C6", "#08519C"), CATS)

## Strip labels for the class facets. label_wrap_gen() breaks only at spaces, so
## "C4 Ambivalent/intermittently destructive" became "C4" plus an over-long
## second line. Break immediately AFTER the slash first, then wrap what remains.
wrap_class <- function(x) {
  x <- sub("/", "/\n", x, fixed = TRUE)
  vapply(strsplit(x, "\n", fixed = TRUE), function(parts)
    paste(vapply(parts, function(p) paste(strwrap(p, width = 16), collapse = "\n"),
                 character(1)), collapse = "\n"),
    character(1), USE.NAMES = FALSE)
}

## ---- glca accessors ---------------------------------------------------------
get_post_list <- function(g) {
  p <- g$posterior
  if (is.matrix(p) || is.data.frame(p)) list(as.matrix(p)) else lapply(p, as.matrix)
}
get_rho <- function(g, group = 1L) {
  r <- g$param$rho
  if (is.list(r) && is.list(r[[1]])) r <- r[[group]]
  r
}
## Top-2 endorsement (categories 3 + 4) per item x class, from a rho list.
top2_mat <- function(rho, K) {
  m <- t(vapply(seq_along(rho), function(j) {
    mm <- as.matrix(rho[[j]]); mm <- mm / rowSums(mm)
    mm[, 3] + mm[, 4]
  }, numeric(K)))
  rownames(m) <- ITEM_LAB; colnames(m) <- paste0("raw", seq_len(K))
  m
}
group_prev <- function(g, group_levels) {
  pl <- get_post_list(g)
  m  <- t(vapply(pl, colMeans, numeric(ncol(pl[[1]]))))
  nm <- names(pl)
  rownames(m) <- if (!is.null(nm) && all(nzchar(nm)) && length(nm) == nrow(m)) nm
                 else if (length(group_levels) == nrow(m)) group_levels
                 else paste0("G", seq_len(nrow(m)))
  colnames(m) <- paste0("raw", seq_len(ncol(m)))
  m
}

## ---- Canonical manuscript numbering ----------------------------------------
## Identical rule to canonical_class_numbering.R, inlined so this file stands alone.
##   C4 = highest (destructive + laissez-faire)
##   C2 = lowest constructive among the remaining three
##   C3 = highest constructive among the remaining two
##   C1 = the last one
MS_LAB <- c("Moderately constructive", "Disengaged", "Constructive",
            "Ambivalent/intermittently destructive")

ms_map <- function(rho_list) {
  K   <- nrow(as.matrix(rho_list[[1]]))
  t2  <- top2_mat(rho_list, K)
  con <- colMeans(t2[ITEM_TYPE == "Constructive",  , drop = FALSE])
  lf  <- colMeans(t2[ITEM_TYPE == "Laissez-faire", , drop = FALSE])
  de  <- colMeans(t2[ITEM_TYPE == "Destructive",   , drop = FALSE])
  stopifnot(K == 4L)
  num <- integer(K)
  i4 <- which.max(de + lf);                num[i4] <- 4L
  r1 <- setdiff(seq_len(K), i4)
  i2 <- r1[which.min(con[r1])];            num[i2] <- 2L
  r2 <- setdiff(r1, i2)
  i3 <- r2[which.max(con[r2])];            num[i3] <- 3L
  i1 <- setdiff(r2, i3);                   num[i1] <- 1L
  stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(num), identical(sort(num), 1:4))
  if (!(con[i3] > con[i1] && con[i1] > con[i2]))
    warning("Constructive ordering is not C3 > C1 > C2; inspect the signature table.")
  list(num = num, lab = MS_LAB[num],
       tag = paste0("C", num, " ", MS_LAB[num]),
       order = order(num),
       signature = data.frame(raw = seq_len(K), manuscript = paste0("C", num),
                              label = MS_LAB[num],
                              constructive = round(100 * con), laissez_faire = round(100 * lf),
                              destructive = round(100 * de), row.names = NULL))
}
```

# 1. Load the saved objects

```{r}
#| label: load-objects
#| results: "hold"

if (!file.exists("lca_results.rds"))
  stop("lca_results.rds not found in ", normalizePath("."),
       ". Set the working directory to the project folder before rendering.")
lca <- readRDS("lca_results.rds")
stopifnot(!is.null(lca$rho4), !is.null(lca$sizes4), !is.null(lca$fit_tbl))
if (length(lca$rho4) != length(ITEM_LAB))
  stop("Item-count mismatch: lca$rho4 has ", length(lca$rho4), " items but the ",
       "metadata has ", length(ITEM_LAB), ". Update ITEM_LAB / ITEM_TYPE.")

## The invariant multiple-group fit: two possible cache shapes.
find_g4inv <- function() {
  cand <- c("cache_g4_inv_part2.rds",
            sort(list.files(".", "^part2_cache_\\d{4}-\\d{2}-\\d{2}\\.rds$"),
                 decreasing = TRUE))
  for (f in cand[file.exists(cand)]) {
    obj <- readRDS(f)
    g   <- if (!is.null(obj$g4_inv)) obj$g4_inv else obj
    if (!is.null(g$param$rho) && !is.null(g$posterior))
      return(list(g = g, src = f))
  }
  NULL
}
mg <- find_g4inv()
HAVE_MG <- !is.null(mg)
if (HAVE_MG) {
  g4_inv <- mg$g
  message("Invariant multiple-group model loaded from: ", mg$src)
} else {
  warning("No invariant multiple-group fit found (cache_g4_inv_part2.rds or ",
          "part2_cache_*.rds). Figures 3 and 4 will be skipped.")
}

map1 <- ms_map(lca$rho4)
cat("\nSingle-sample model, raw glca index to manuscript class:\n")
print(map1$signature, row.names = FALSE)

if (HAVE_MG) {
  rho_inv <- get_rho(g4_inv)
  mapM    <- ms_map(rho_inv)
  cat("\nInvariant multiple-group model, raw glca index to manuscript class:\n")
  print(mapM$signature, row.names = FALSE)
}
```

# 2. Verification: same order, same percentages

The values below are the ones reported in the manuscript. If any of them moved,
the render stops here rather than producing a figure that disagrees with its table.

```{r}
#| label: verify

TOL    <- 0.15    # percentage points; the manuscript reports one decimal
STRICT <- FALSE   # TRUE = a class-size mismatch stops the render as well

## ---- A. Class order (fatal: the figures depend on it) -----------------------
## Part 1 already permutes rho4, post4, modal4 and sizes4 into canonical slots,
## so the mapping recomputed from the signature should be the identity. It is
## recomputed rather than assumed, because that is the assumption that silently
## breaks when a model is refitted.
cat("Canonical mapping recomputed from rho4 (expected: raw i -> C i):\n")
print(map1$signature, row.names = FALSE)
if (!identical(as.integer(map1$num), 1:4))
  stop("rho4 is not in canonical order: raw class ", paste(map1$num, collapse = ", "),
       " maps to C1..C4. Figures would be mislabelled; stop and inspect Part 1's ",
       "permutation block before continuing.")

## ---- B. Class size: three different quantities, kept apart ------------------
## pi_k   = model-estimated prevalence, colMeans of the posteriors
## w_sh   = survey-weighted share of the modal classification
## n_md   = unweighted modal counts
pi_k <- 100 * colMeans(as.matrix(lca$post4))
w_sh <- 100 * as.numeric(lca$sizes4)
n_md <- as.integer(table(factor(lca$modal4, levels = 1:4)))

target_pct <- c(25.1, 16.3, 28.0, 30.7)     # percentages reported in the manuscript
target_n   <- c(496, 322, 554, 607)         # counts reported in the manuscript

chk1 <- data.frame(
  Class               = paste0("C", 1:4),
  Label               = MS_LAB,
  `Manuscript %`      = target_pct,
  `pi_k %`            = round(pi_k, 1),
  `Weighted modal %`  = round(w_sh, 1),
  `Manuscript n`      = target_n,
  `Modal n`           = n_md,
  check.names = FALSE)
cat("\nRetained four-class solution, class size by definition:\n")
print(chk1, row.names = FALSE)
cat(sprintf("\nModal n sums to %d (current 13-item classification); the manuscript's counts sum to %d.\n",
            sum(n_md), sum(target_n)))

ok_pct <- all(abs(pi_k - target_pct) <= TOL)
ok_n   <- all(n_md == target_n)
if (ok_pct)
  cat("OK: the reported percentages reproduce the model-estimated prevalence (pi_k).\n")
if (!ok_pct)
  (if (STRICT) stop else warning)(
    "The manuscript percentages do not match pi_k either; inspect before submitting.")
if (!ok_n)
  (if (STRICT) stop else warning)(
    "MANUSCRIPT ACTION NEEDED. The counts reported in Table 2 and in the Results ",
    "(", paste(target_n, collapse = ", "), "; sum ", sum(target_n), ") do not come ",
    "from the current 13-item classification, whose modal counts are ",
    paste(n_md, collapse = ", "), " (sum ", sum(n_md), "). They are pi_k multiplied ",
    "by the superseded classified n of 1,977. The percentages are fine (they are ",
    "pi_k), the counts are not. This does not affect Figures 1 to 4, which do not ",
    "display class sizes, so the render continues.")

## ---- Invariant model: prevalence by setting ---------------------------------
if (HAVE_MG) {
  GL   <- c("General salaried", "Hospital HCW")
  prev <- 100 * group_prev(g4_inv, GL)
  ## columns are raw classes; move them into manuscript order C1..C4
  prev_ms <- prev[, mapM$order, drop = FALSE]
  colnames(prev_ms) <- paste0("C", 1:4)
  target_prev <- rbind(`General salaried` = c(27.8, 18.1, 26.4, 27.7),
                       `Hospital HCW`     = c(33.1,  3.6, 23.5, 39.7))
  colnames(target_prev) <- paste0("C", 1:4)
  ## align row order with the target regardless of how glca named the groups
  if (!all(rownames(prev_ms) %in% rownames(target_prev))) {
    warning("Group names from glca (", paste(rownames(prev_ms), collapse = ", "),
            ") do not match the expected settings; assuming the order ",
            paste(GL, collapse = ", "), ".")
    rownames(prev_ms) <- GL
  }
  prev_ms <- prev_ms[rownames(target_prev), , drop = FALSE]

  cat("\nInvariant model, class prevalence by setting (%):\n")
  print(round(prev_ms, 1))
  cat("\nManuscript (Table S3):\n"); print(target_prev)
  cat("\nDifference (recomputed minus manuscript):\n")
  print(round(prev_ms - target_prev, 2))
  if (any(abs(prev_ms - target_prev) > TOL))
    stop("Per-setting prevalences do not reproduce Table S3 (tolerance ", TOL,
         " pp). The cached multiple-group fit is not the one behind the ",
         "manuscript; re-render the multigroup notebook in FINAL mode before ",
         "regenerating Figures 3 and 4.")
  cat("\nOK: class order and percentages reproduce the manuscript.\n")
}
```

# 3. Figure 1 — class enumeration with adjacent-solution ARI

```{r}
#| label: fig1
#| fig-width: 6.85
#| fig-height: 5.9
#| results: "hold"

## Per-k modal assignments: exported by Part 1, or written by
## refit_enumeration_modal.R, or restored from a knitr cache of Part 1's
## `enumeration` chunk. Every source is validated against Table 1's
## log-likelihoods before use. If table1_enumeration_ari.csv already exists it is
## reused, since it was produced by exactly this validation.
fit_tbl  <- as.data.frame(lca$fit_tbl)
fit_tbl  <- fit_tbl[order(fit_tbl$Classes), ]
ks       <- as.integer(fit_tbl$Classes)
retained <- if (!is.null(lca$retained)) as.integer(lca$retained) else 4L
ll_rep   <- fit_tbl$logLik[match(ks, fit_tbl$Classes)]

gof_ll <- function(g) { gg <- g$gof; v <- gg[["loglik"]]
  if (is.null(v)) v <- gg[["logLik"]]; if (is.null(v)) NA_real_ else as.numeric(v)[1] }
post_of <- function(g) { p <- g$posterior; if (is.list(p)) p <- p[[1]]; as.matrix(p) }

ari <- function(a, b) {
  tab <- table(a, b); n <- sum(tab); ch2 <- function(x) x * (x - 1) / 2
  sij <- sum(ch2(tab)); sa <- sum(ch2(rowSums(tab))); sb <- sum(ch2(colSums(tab)))
  ex <- sa * sb / ch2(n); mx <- (sa + sb) / 2
  if (isTRUE(all.equal(mx, ex))) 1 else (sij - ex) / (mx - ex)
}
purity <- function(prev, cur) { t <- table(cur, prev); sum(apply(t, 1, max)) / sum(t) }

enum_csv <- "table1_enumeration_ari.csv"
if (file.exists(enum_csv)) {
  enum_tbl <- as.data.frame(readr::read_csv(enum_csv, show_col_types = FALSE))
  message("Enumeration diagnostics reused from ", enum_csv)
} else {
  modal_all <- NULL
  if (!is.null(lca$modal_all)) {
    modal_all <- lca$modal_all
    if (is.null(names(modal_all))) names(modal_all) <- paste0("k", ks)
  }
  if (is.null(modal_all) && file.exists("enumeration_modal_all.rds")) {
    ma <- readRDS("enumeration_modal_all.rds")
    if (is.list(ma$modal_all) && all(abs(ma$logLik[as.character(ks)] - ll_rep) < 1e-3))
      modal_all <- ma$modal_all
  }
  if (is.null(modal_all)) {
    dirs <- unique(c("cache", "leadership_LCA_analysis_cache",
                     list.dirs(".", recursive = FALSE)[
                       grepl("cache", list.dirs(".", recursive = FALSE))]))
    for (cf in list.files(dirs, "^enumeration_[0-9a-f]+\\.rdx$",
                          recursive = TRUE, full.names = TRUE)) {
      e <- new.env(parent = emptyenv())
      ok <- tryCatch({ lazyLoad(sub("\\.rdx$", "", cf), envir = e); TRUE },
                     error = function(err) FALSE)
      if (!ok || !exists("fits", envir = e, inherits = FALSE)) { rm(e); next }
      f <- get("fits", envir = e); rm(e)
      llc <- vapply(ks, function(k) if (!is.null(f[[k]])) gof_ll(f[[k]]) else NA_real_, numeric(1))
      if (all(is.finite(llc)) && all(abs(llc - ll_rep) < 1e-3)) {
        modal_all <- setNames(lapply(ks, function(k)
          max.col(post_of(f[[k]]), ties.method = "first")), paste0("k", ks))
        break
      }
    }
  }
  if (is.null(modal_all))
    stop("Figure 1 needs the per-k modal assignments. Run  ",
         "source(\"refit_enumeration_modal.R\")  once, or render ",
         "chunk_fig1_enumeration_ARI.qmd, which writes ", enum_csv, ".")
  enum_tbl <- fit_tbl |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      ari_prev = vapply(Classes, function(k) if (k == min(ks)) NA_real_ else
        ari(modal_all[[paste0("k", k - 1L)]], modal_all[[paste0("k", k)]]), numeric(1)),
      purity_prev = vapply(Classes, function(k) if (k == min(ks)) NA_real_ else
        purity(modal_all[[paste0("k", k - 1L)]], modal_all[[paste0("k", k)]]), numeric(1)))
}

share_tbl <- enum_tbl |>
  dplyr::select(Classes, AIC, BIC, CAIC, SABIC, AWE) |>
  tidyr::pivot_longer(-Classes, names_to = "Criterion", values_to = "value") |>
  dplyr::group_by(Criterion) |>
  dplyr::mutate(share = 100 * (value[Classes == min(Classes)] - value) /
                        (value[Classes == min(Classes)] - min(value)),
                k_min = Classes[which.min(value)]) |>
  dplyr::ungroup() |>
  dplyr::mutate(Criterion = factor(Criterion, levels = c("AIC", "BIC", "CAIC", "SABIC", "AWE")))

okabe  <- c(AIC = "#0072B2", BIC = "#D55E00", CAIC = "#CC79A7", SABIC = "#009E73", AWE = "#000000")
shapes <- c(AIC = 16, BIC = 17, CAIC = 15, SABIC = 18, AWE = 4)
ltys   <- c(AIC = "solid", BIC = "solid", CAIC = "dashed", SABIC = "dotted", AWE = "longdash")
band   <- annotate("rect", xmin = retained - .5, xmax = retained + .5,
                   ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf, fill = "grey88", alpha = .6)
th1 <- theme_j() + theme(panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
                         panel.grid.major.y = element_line(linewidth = .25, colour = "grey88"),
                         legend.title = element_blank())

p1a <- ggplot(share_tbl, aes(Classes, share, colour = Criterion, shape = Criterion,
                             linetype = Criterion)) +
  band + geom_line(linewidth = .5) + geom_point(size = 1.7) +
  geom_point(data = dplyr::filter(share_tbl, Classes == k_min), shape = 21, size = 3.6,
             stroke = .6, colour = "grey20", show.legend = FALSE) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = okabe) + scale_shape_manual(values = shapes) +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = ltys) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = ks) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 100), breaks = seq(0, 100, 25)) +
  labs(x = "Number of latent classes", y = "Share of total decrease (%)") + th1

d1 <- tibble::tibble(Classes = enum_tbl$Classes,
                     `Relative entropy` = enum_tbl$Entropy,
                     `Mean AvePP` = enum_tbl$`Mean AvePP`,
                     `ARI (k-1 vs k)` = enum_tbl$ari_prev) |>
  tidyr::pivot_longer(-Classes, names_to = "Metric", values_to = "value") |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(value)) |>
  dplyr::mutate(Metric = factor(Metric, levels = c("Relative entropy", "Mean AvePP", "ARI (k-1 vs k)")))

p1b <- ggplot(d1, aes(Classes, value, colour = Metric, shape = Metric, linetype = Metric)) +
  band + geom_line(linewidth = .5) + geom_point(size = 1.7) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("#0072B2", "#009E73", "#D55E00")) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(16, 15, 17)) +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = c("solid", "dashed", "solid")) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = ks, limits = range(ks) + c(-.5, .5)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), breaks = seq(0, 1, .2)) +
  labs(x = "Number of latent classes", y = "Index (0 to 1)") + th1

p1c <- ggplot(enum_tbl, aes(Classes, `Smallest %`)) +
  band + geom_col(width = .6, fill = "grey55") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 5, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey30") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = ks) +
  labs(x = "Number of latent classes", y = "Smallest class (% of sample)") + th1

fig1 <- p1a / (p1b | p1c) + patchwork::plot_layout(heights = c(1.2, 1)) +
  patchwork::plot_annotation(tag_levels = "a")
fig1
save_fig(fig1, "Fig1_enumeration", 150)
```

# 4. Figure 2 — item-response probabilities, retained four-class solution

```{r}
#| label: fig2
#| fig-width: 6.85
#| fig-height: 6.3
#| results: "hold"

## Long form from the fitted rho: rows = raw class, cols = response category.
## The raw index is translated to the manuscript class here and nowhere else.
rho_long <- function(rho_list, map) {
  do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_along(rho_list), function(j) {
    m <- as.matrix(rho_list[[j]]); m <- m / rowSums(m)
    data.frame(
      item     = factor(ITEM_LAB[j], levels = rev(ITEM_LAB)),
      type     = ITEM_TYPE[j],
      class    = factor(rep(map$tag, times = ncol(m)), levels = map$tag[map$order]),
      category = factor(rep(CATS, each = nrow(m)), levels = CATS),
      prob     = as.vector(m))
  }))
}

d2 <- rho_long(lca$rho4, map1)
stopifnot(identical(levels(d2$class), map1$tag[map1$order]))   # C1 -> C4 order locked

fig2 <- ggplot(d2, aes(prob, item, fill = category)) +
  geom_col(width = .8, colour = "white", linewidth = .15,
           position = position_stack(reverse = TRUE)) +
  facet_grid(type ~ class, scales = "free_y", space = "free_y", switch = "y",
             labeller = labeller(class = as_labeller(wrap_class))) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = CAT_PAL, name = "Response",
                    guide = guide_legend(nrow = 1)) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(0, .5, 1), labels = c("0", "50", "100"),
                     expand = expansion(mult = .03)) +
  labs(x = "Response-category probability (%)", y = NULL) +
  theme_j() +
  theme(strip.placement = "outside",
        strip.text.y.left = element_text(angle = 0, face = "bold"),
        panel.spacing.x = grid::unit(.5, "lines"),
        axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = BASE - 1))
fig2
save_fig(fig2, "Fig2_itemprob", 165)
```

# 5. Figure 3 — shared item-response probabilities under invariance

Under `measure.inv = TRUE` a single set of item-response probabilities describes
both settings, so the honest display is one panel set of shared classes, with the
setting difference carried entirely by Figure 4. The per-setting solutions fitted
separately are a supporting check; they cannot be redrawn here because those two
single-group fits are not saved by any notebook (see the note at the end).

```{r}
#| label: fig3
#| fig-width: 6.85
#| fig-height: 6.3
#| results: "hold"

if (!HAVE_MG) {
  message("Figure 3 skipped: no invariant multiple-group fit available.")
} else {
  d3 <- rho_long(rho_inv, mapM)
  stopifnot(identical(levels(d3$class), mapM$tag[mapM$order]))

  fig3 <- ggplot(d3, aes(prob, item, fill = category)) +
    geom_col(width = .8, colour = "white", linewidth = .15,
             position = position_stack(reverse = TRUE)) +
    facet_grid(type ~ class, scales = "free_y", space = "free_y", switch = "y",
               labeller = labeller(class = as_labeller(wrap_class))) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = CAT_PAL, name = "Response",
                      guide = guide_legend(nrow = 1)) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(0, .5, 1), labels = c("0", "50", "100"),
                       expand = expansion(mult = .03)) +
    labs(x = "Response-category probability (%)", y = NULL) +
    theme_j() +
    theme(strip.placement = "outside",
          strip.text.y.left = element_text(angle = 0, face = "bold"),
          panel.spacing.x = grid::unit(.5, "lines"),
          axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
          axis.text.y = element_text(size = BASE - 1))
  print(fig3)
  save_fig(fig3, "Fig3_invariant_profiles", 165)
}
```

# 6. Figure 4 — class prevalence by setting

```{r}
#| label: fig4
#| fig-width: 6.85
#| fig-height: 3.5
#| results: "hold"

if (!HAVE_MG) {
  message("Figure 4 skipped: no invariant multiple-group fit available.")
} else {
  d4 <- as.data.frame(prev_ms) |>
    tibble::rownames_to_column("Setting") |>
    tidyr::pivot_longer(-Setting, names_to = "Class", values_to = "Prevalence") |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      Class = factor(Class, levels = paste0("C", 1:4),
                     labels = paste0("C", 1:4, "\n", MS_LAB)),
      Setting = factor(Setting, levels = c("General salaried", "Hospital HCW"),
                       labels = c("General salaried workers (n= 1,847)",
                                  "Hospital healthcare workers (n= 972)")))

  fig4 <- ggplot(d4, aes(Class, Prevalence, fill = Setting)) +
    geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = .78), width = .68,
             colour = "grey25", linewidth = .25) +
    geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.1f", Prevalence)),
              position = position_dodge(width = .78), vjust = -0.45,
              size = (BASE - 1.5) / .pt, family = FAM) +
    ## Dark blue vs light amber: the pair differs in hue AND in luminance, so the
    ## bars stay distinguishable in greyscale; the printed values make it explicit.
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("#0072B2", "#E69F00")) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, max(d4$Prevalence) * 1.18),
                       expand = expansion(mult = c(0, .02))) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = "Prevalence (%)", fill = NULL) +
    theme_j() +
    theme(panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
          panel.grid.major.y = element_line(linewidth = .25, colour = "grey88"),
          axis.text.x = element_text(size = BASE - 0.5, lineheight = 1.05))
  print(fig4)
  save_fig(fig4, "Fig4_prevalences", 95)
}
```

# 8. What was regenerated, and what still needs a decision

```{r}
#| label: session
#| results: "hold"

cat("Files written to ", normalizePath("."), ":\n", sep = "")
print(list.files(".", "^Fig[1-4]_.*\\.(png|tiff|pdf|eps)$"))
cat("\n")
sessionInfo()
```

**Figure 3 is a substantive choice, not a relabelling.** The manuscript's current
Figure 3 shows the four-class solutions fitted *separately* in each setting. Those
two single-group fits (`g4_gen`, `g4_hosp` in
`leadership_LCA_multigroup_hospital.qmd`) are refitted at every render and are not
saved to any `.rds`, so they cannot be redrawn from the objects in this folder.
This file therefore draws Figure 3 from the **invariant** model instead, which is
reproducible from `cache_g4_inv_part2.rds` and is arguably the figure the argument
calls for: once invariance is claimed, the profiles are shared by construction and
the setting difference lives entirely in Figure 4.

Two ways forward, both legitimate:

1. **Keep the invariant-profile figure as Fig. 3** (what this file produces) and
   move the separately fitted comparison to the supplement as an Online Resource,
   regenerated the next time the multigroup notebook is rendered.
2. **Keep the per-setting comparison as Fig. 3.** Then add
   `saveRDS(list(g4_gen = g4_gen, g4_hosp = g4_hosp), "mg_separate_fits.rds")`
   to the `profile-comparison` chunk of `leadership_LCA_multigroup_hospital.qmd`,
   render it once in FINAL mode, and this file can be extended to read that object
   and redraw it with the canonical labels.
